```
    10	import Foundation
    11	
    12	/// Helper methods for dealing with filesystem locations specific to the app.
    13	///
    14	/// Currently this type exposes a convenience method for creating paths inside the
    15	/// app's "Application Support" directory.  Centralizing the logic ensures that
    16	/// every component writes to the same location and the directory gets created when needed.
    17	enum AppDirectories {
    18	    /// Returns a file URL inside the application's Application Support folder, creating the folder if needed.
    19	    /// - Parameter fileName: The name of the file.
    20	    /// - Returns: The full URL to the file within the application's support directory.
    21	    static func applicationSupportFile(named fileName: String) -> URL {
    22	        let fileManager = FileManager.default
    23	
    24	        // Base location for all Application Support files.
    25	        let appSupportURL = fileManager.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask)[0]
    26	
    27	        // Use the bundle identifier to create an app-specific subdirectory so our
    28	        // files don't collide with those from other apps.
    29	        let bundleID = Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier ?? "DefaultApp"
    30	        let appDirectory = appSupportURL.appendingPathComponent(bundleID)
    31	
    32	        // Create the directory if it doesn't already exist.
    33	        if !fileManager.fileExists(atPath: appDirectory.path) {
    34	            try? fileManager.createDirectory(at: appDirectory, withIntermediateDirectories: true, attributes: nil)
    35	        }
    36	
    37	        // Append the desired file name to obtain the final file URL.
    38	        return appDirectory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
    39	    }
    40	}
```

```
    18	/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker) and writes them into
    19	/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.
    20	enum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {
    21	    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {
    22	        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
    23	            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)
    24	
    25	            // Render both light and dark variants so widgets can pick based on appearance.
    26	            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .light)
    27	            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .dark)
    28	        }
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    @MainActor
    32	    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, size: CGSize, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {
    33	        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID, style: style) else { return }
    34	
    35	        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()
    36	        options.size = size
    37	        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale
    38	        options.mapType = .standard
    39	        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll
    40	        options.showsBuildings = false
    41	        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)
    42	        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)
    43	
    44	        do {
    45	            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()
    46	            let markerImage = await markerImage(for: device)
    47	            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size, markerImage: markerImage)
    48	            if let data = image.pngData() {
    49	                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])
    50	            }
    51	        } catch {
    52	            debugLog("Failed to generate widget map snapshot (\(style == .dark ? "dark" : "light")): \(error)")
    53	        }
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -> MKCoordinateRegion {
    57	        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000
    58	        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)
    59	        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)
    60	        return MKCoordinateRegion(
    61	            center: coordinate,
    62	            latitudinalMeters: radius,
    63	            longitudinalMeters: radius
    64	        )
    65	    }
    66	
    67	    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -> UIImage {
    68	        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)
    69	
    70	        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
    71	        return renderer.image { context in
    72	            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))
    73	
    74	            // Draw marker
    75	            let markerSize = markerImage.size
    76	            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(
    77	                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,
    78	                y: point.y - markerSize.height
    79	            )
    80	            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))
    81	        }
    82	    }

    84	    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -> UIImage {
    85	        await MainActor.run {

    88	                height: 44,
    89	                cacheEnabled: false,
    90	                renderPadding: 10

    92	            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)

    94	            renderer.isOpaque = false
    95	            return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: "mappin.circle.fill") ?? UIImage()
    96	        }
    97	    }
    98	}
```

```
    49	    // Serialized sync queue using an actor

    53	        
    54	        func enqueue(_ operation: @escaping () async throws -> Void) async throws {
    55	            // If already syncing, wait for it to complete
    56	            while isSyncing {
    57	                try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000) // 0.1 seconds
    58	            }
    59	            
    60	            isSyncing = true
    61	            defer { isSyncing = false }
    62	            
    63	            try await operation()
    64	        }

    71	    /// Activates the allowed device list feature and seeds initial ACL list to server

    75	            throw AllowedDeviceListError.deviceKeyMissing
```

```
    33	    func execute<T>(
    34	        policy: MiataruRetryPolicy,
    35	        operationName: String,
    36	        operation: () async throws -> T
    37	    ) async throws -> T {
    38	        var currentAttempt = 0
    39	        var remainingRetries = max(0, policy.maxRetries)
    40	
    41	        while true {
    42	            do {
    43	                return try await operation()
    44	            } catch {
    45	                guard remainingRetries > 0, MiataruRetryClassifier.isRetryable(error) else {
    46	                    throw error
    47	                }
    48	
    49	                remainingRetries -= 1
    50	                currentAttempt += 1
    51	
    52	                let delay = policy.delaySeconds(
    53	                    forRetryAttempt: currentAttempt,
    54	                    jitterProvider: jitterProvider
    55	                )
    56	                let nanoseconds = UInt64(max(0, delay) * 1_000_000_000)
    57	                if nanoseconds > 0 {
    58	                    try await sleepHandler(nanoseconds)
    59	                }
    60	
    61	                debugLog("[MiataruRequestExecutor] Retry \(currentAttempt)/\(policy.maxRetries) for \(operationName)")
    62	            }
    63	        }
    64	    }
```

_**User (2026-05-21 14:21:53Z)**_

PLEASE IMPLEMENT THIS PLAN:
# Sicherer App-Daten-Cleanup Für Miataru

## Summary
- Cleanup darf nur abgeleitete Cache-Daten löschen: alte Location-Cache-Einträge, Slogan-Cache-Einträge und alte Widget-Snapshot-PNGs.
- Gerätelisten, eigene Device-ID, DeviceKey, Groups und Settings bleiben unberührt.
- Der Retain-Set wird konservativ gebaut: bekannte Geräte, eigene Device-ID und alle in Gruppen referenzierten Device-IDs werden immer behalten.

## Key Changes
- Zentrale Cleanup-Routine einführen, z. B. `PersistentDataCleanup`, die niemals diese Daten löscht oder überschreibt: `knownDevices.plist`, `deviceGroups.plist`, `deviceIDmodern.txt`, legacy `deviceID.plist`, Settings-`UserDefaults`, DeviceKey, Onboarding-Flags und `SharedWidgetConfig.json`.
- `DeviceLocationCacheStore` bekommt nur eine Prune-Methode für Einträge außerhalb des Retain-Sets; das eigene Gerät wird zusätzlich hart geschützt.
- `DeviceSloganCacheStore` bekommt eine Prune-Methode für Slogan-/Fetch-Metadaten außerhalb des Retain-Sets; keine Settings-Keys werden angefasst.
- `SharedWidgetDataManager` löscht nur Snapshot-Dateien mit bekannten Präfixen `WidgetMapSnapshot-` und legacy `MapSnapshot-`, wenn deren Device-ID nicht im Retain-Set ist.
- Cleanup läuft nach App-Start und nach Device-Entfernung; vor jeder Löschung wird der Retain-Set frisch aus den aktuellen Stores gelesen.

## Safety Tests
- Test: `knownDevices.plist`, `deviceGroups.plist`, eigene Device-ID-Datei und Settings-Keys werden vom Cleanup nicht verändert.
- Test: bekannte Geräte, eigene Device-ID und Gruppenreferenzen bleiben in Location-/Slogan-Caches erhalten.
- Test: nur alte unbekannte Device-IDs werden aus Location-/Slogan-Caches entfernt.
- Test: Snapshot-Cleanup löscht nur `WidgetMapSnapshot-*`/`MapSnapshot-*` für nicht retainte IDs und ignoriert alle anderen App-Group-Dateien.
- Ausführen: `miataru/scripts/test-unit.sh`.

## Assumptions
- Alte unbekannte Besucher-Daten dürfen entfernt werden, weil sie Cache sind und bei Bedarf neu geladen werden.
- Device-Listen, eigene Identität und Settings gelten als Primärdaten und sind außerhalb des Cleanup-Scope.

```diff
+    @discardableResult
+    static func removeStaleMapSnapshots(
+        retainingDeviceIDs retainedDeviceIDs: Set<String>,
+        in containerURL: URL? = sharedContainerURL,
+        fileManager: FileManager = .default
+    ) -> WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult {
+        guard let containerURL else {
+            return WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult(removedFileCount: 0, removedByteCount: 0)
+        }
+
+        let normalizedRetainedDeviceIDs = Set(
+            retainedDeviceIDs
+                .map(normalizedDeviceID)
+                .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
+        )
+        guard let contents = try? fileManager.contentsOfDirectory(
+            at: containerURL,
+            includingPropertiesForKeys: [.fileSizeKey, .isRegularFileKey],
+            options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
+        ) else {
+            return WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult(removedFileCount: 0, removedByteCount: 0)
+        }
+
+        var removedFileCount = 0
+        var removedByteCount: Int64 = 0
+
+        for fileURL in contents {
+            guard let deviceID = snapshotDeviceID(from: fileURL.lastPathComponent),
+                  !normalizedRetainedDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedDeviceID(deviceID)) else {
+                continue
+            }
+
+            let fileSize = snapshotFileSize(fileURL, fileManager: fileManager)
+            do {
+                try fileManager.removeItem(at: fileURL)
+                removedFileCount += 1
+                removedByteCount += fileSize
+            } catch {
+                debugLog("Failed to remove stale widget map snapshot \(fileURL.lastPathComponent): \(error)")
+            }
+        }
+
+        return WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult(
+            removedFileCount: removedFileCount,
+            removedByteCount: removedByteCount
+        )
+    }
+
+    private static func snapshotDeviceID(from fileName: String) -> String? {
+        guard fileName.lowercased().hasSuffix(".\(snapshotExtension)") else { return nil }
+        guard let prefix = cleanupSnapshotPrefixes.first(where: { fileName.hasPrefix($0) }) else { return nil }
+
+        let withoutPrefix = String(fileName.dropFirst(prefix.count))
+        let withoutExtension = String(withoutPrefix.dropLast(snapshotExtension.count + 1))
+        let deviceID: String
+        if withoutExtension.hasSuffix("-dark") {
+            deviceID = String(withoutExtension.dropLast("-dark".count))
+        } else if withoutExtension.hasSuffix("-light") {
+            deviceID = String(withoutExtension.dropLast("-light".count))
+        } else {
+            deviceID = withoutExtension
+        }
+
+        return deviceID.isEmpty ? nil : deviceID
+    }
+
+    private static func snapshotFileSize(_ fileURL: URL, fileManager: FileManager) -> Int64 {
+        if let values = try? fileURL.resourceValues(forKeys: [.fileSizeKey]),
+           let fileSize = values.fileSize {
+            return Int64(fileSize)
+        }
+        if let attributes = try? fileManager.attributesOfItem(atPath: fileURL.path),
+           let fileSize = attributes[.size] as? NSNumber {
+            return fileSize.int64Value
+        }
+        return 0
+    }
+
+    private static func normalizedDeviceID(_ deviceID: String) -> String {
+        deviceID.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).uppercased()
+    }
```

```diff
+/*
+ * Copyright (c) 2013-2026, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
+ *
+ * PersistentDataCleanup.swift
+ * miataru
+ *
+ * Created by Codex on 21.05.26.
+ */
+
+import Foundation
+
+struct PersistentDataCleanupResult: Equatable {
+    let removedLocationCount: Int
+    let removedSloganDeviceCount: Int
+    let removedSnapshotFileCount: Int
+    let removedSnapshotByteCount: Int64
+
+    var didRemoveAnything: Bool {
+        removedLocationCount > 0 || removedSloganDeviceCount > 0 || removedSnapshotFileCount > 0
+    }
+}
+
+@MainActor
+enum PersistentDataCleanup {
+    @discardableResult
+    static func run(snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {
+        run(
+            knownDevices: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices,
+            groups: DeviceGroupStore.shared.groups,
+            ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,
+            snapshotContainerURL: snapshotContainerURL
+        )
+    }
+
+    @discardableResult
+    static func run(
+        knownDevices: [KnownDevice],
+        groups: [DeviceGroup],
+        ownDeviceID: String,
+        snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL
+    ) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {
+        let retainedDeviceIDs = retainedDeviceIDs(
+            knownDevices: knownDevices,
+            groups: groups,
+            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID
+        )
+
+        let removedLocationCount = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.pruneLocations(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs
+        )
+        let removedSloganDeviceCount = DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.pruneCachedData(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs
+        )
+        let snapshotResult = SharedWidgetDataManager.removeStaleMapSnapshots(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs,
+            in: snapshotContainerURL
+        )
+
+        let result = PersistentDataCleanupResult(
+            removedLocationCount: removedLocationCount,
+            removedSloganDeviceCount: removedSloganDeviceCount,
+            removedSnapshotFileCount: snapshotResult.removedFileCount,
+            removedSnapshotByteCount: snapshotResult.removedByteCount
+        )
+
+        if result.didRemoveAnything {
+            debugLog(
+                "[PersistentDataCleanup] Removed \(result.removedLocationCount) location cache entries, " +
+                "\(result.removedSloganDeviceCount) slogan cache entries, " +
+                "\(result.removedSnapshotFileCount) widget snapshots (\(result.removedSnapshotByteCount) bytes)."
+            )
+        }
+
+        return result
+    }
+
+    static func retainedDeviceIDs(
+        knownDevices: [KnownDevice],
+        groups: [DeviceGroup],
+        ownDeviceID: String
+    ) -> Set<String> {
+        var retained = Set<String>()
+
+        for device in knownDevices {
+            insertNormalized(device.DeviceID, into: &retained)
+        }
+        for group in groups {
+            for deviceID in group.deviceIDs {
+                insertNormalized(deviceID, into: &retained)
+            }
+        }
+        insertNormalized(ownDeviceID, into: &retained)
+
+        return retained
+    }
+
+    private static func insertNormalized(_ deviceID: String, into retained: inout Set<String>) {
+        let normalized = deviceID.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).uppercased()
+        guard !normalized.isEmpty else { return }
+        retained.insert(normalized)
+    }
+}
```

```diff
+/*
+ * Copyright (c) 2013-2026, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
+ *
+ * PersistentDataCleanupTests.swift
+ * miataruTests
+ *
+ * Created by Codex on 21.05.26.
+ */
+
+import Foundation
+import Testing
+@testable import miataru
+
+@MainActor
+@Suite("Persistent data cleanup")
+struct PersistentDataCleanupTests {
+    @Test("Retain set includes known devices, group references, and own device")
+    func retainedDeviceIDsAreConservative() {
+        let known = KnownDevice(name: "Known", deviceID: "known-device")
+        let own = "own-device"
+        let groupOnly = "group-only-device"
+        let group = DeviceGroup(name: "Group")
+        group.addDevice(groupOnly)
+
+        let retained = PersistentDataCleanup.retainedDeviceIDs(
+            knownDevices: [known],
+            groups: [group],
+            ownDeviceID: own
+        )
+
+        #expect(retained == ["KNOWN-DEVICE", "GROUP-ONLY-DEVICE", "OWN-DEVICE"])
+    }
+
+    @Test("Location pruning keeps retained and own devices only")
+    func locationPruningKeepsRetainedAndOwnDevices() {
+        let fileURL = temporaryDirectory().appendingPathComponent("deviceLocations.plist")
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: fileURL.deletingLastPathComponent()) }
+
+        let store = DeviceLocationCacheStore(fileURL: fileURL, shouldSyncWidgetData: false)
+        let known = "LOCATION_KEEP_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let groupOnly = "LOCATION_GROUP_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let own = "LOCATION_OWN_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let stale = "LOCATION_STALE_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+
+        store.setLocation(for: known, latitude: 1, longitude: 1, accuracy: 5, timestamp: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1))
+        store.setLocation(for: groupOnly, latitude: 2, longitude: 2, accuracy: 5, timestamp: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 2))
+        store.setLocation(for: own, latitude: 3, longitude: 3, accuracy: 5, timestamp: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 3))
+        store.setLocation(for: stale, latitude: 4, longitude: 4, accuracy: 5, timestamp: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 4))
+
+        let removed = store.pruneLocations(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: [known.lowercased(), groupOnly],
+            protectingOwnDeviceID: own
+        )
+
+        #expect(removed == 1)
+        #expect(store.getLocation(for: known) != nil)
+        #expect(store.getLocation(for: groupOnly) != nil)
+        #expect(store.getLocation(for: own) != nil)
+        #expect(store.getLocation(for: stale) == nil)
+    }
+
+    @Test("Slogan pruning keeps retained and own devices without touching settings")
+    func sloganPruningKeepsRetainedAndOwnDevices() throws {
+        let suiteName = "PersistentDataCleanupTests.\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let defaults = try #require(UserDefaults(suiteName: suiteName))
+        defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suiteName)
+        defer { defaults.removePersistentDomain(forName: suiteName) }
+
+        defaults.set("device-key-sentinel", forKey: SettingsKeys.deviceKey)
+        defaults.set(true, forKey: "hasCompletedOnboarding")
+
+        let store = DeviceSloganCacheStore(defaults: defaults)
+        let known = "SLOGAN_KEEP_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let groupOnly = "SLOGAN_GROUP_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let own = "SLOGAN_OWN_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+        let stale = "SLOGAN_STALE_\(UUID().uuidString)"
+
+        store.cacheSlogan("known", for: known)
+        store.cacheSlogan("group", for: groupOnly)
+        store.cacheSlogan("own", for: own)
+        store.cacheSlogan("stale", for: stale)
+        store.markFreshNow(for: stale)
+
+        let removed = store.pruneCachedData(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: [known, groupOnly.lowercased()],
+            protectingOwnDeviceID: own
+        )
+
+        #expect(removed == 1)
+        #expect(store.slogan(for: known) == "known")
+        #expect(store.slogan(for: groupOnly) == "group")
+        #expect(store.slogan(for: own) == "own")
+        #expect(store.slogan(for: stale) == nil)
+        #expect(!store.isKnown(for: stale))
+        #expect(defaults.string(forKey: SettingsKeys.deviceKey) == "device-key-sentinel")
+        #expect(defaults.bool(forKey: "hasCompletedOnboarding"))
+    }
+
+    @Test("Snapshot cleanup removes only stale map snapshots")
+    func snapshotCleanupOnlyRemovesStaleMapSnapshots() throws {
+        let directory = temporaryDirectory()
+        defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: directory) }
+
+        try write(bytes: [1, 2, 3], named: "WidgetMapSnapshot-KEEP-light.png", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [4, 5, 6, 7], named: "MapSnapshot-GROUP-dark.png", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [8, 9, 10, 11, 12], named: "WidgetMapSnapshot-STALE-light.png", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18], named: "MapSnapshot-STALE.png", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [19], named: "SharedWidgetConfig.json", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [20], named: "knownDevices.plist", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [21], named: "deviceGroups.plist", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [22], named: "deviceIDmodern.txt", in: directory)
+        try write(bytes: [23], named: "deviceID.plist", in: directory)
+
+        let result = SharedWidgetDataManager.removeStaleMapSnapshots(
+            retainingDeviceIDs: ["KEEP", "GROUP"],
+            in: directory
+        )
+
+        #expect(result.removedFileCount == 2)
+        #expect(result.removedByteCount == 11)
+        #expect(fileExists("WidgetMapSnapshot-KEEP-light.png", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("MapSnapshot-GROUP-dark.png", in: directory))
+        #expect(!fileExists("WidgetMapSnapshot-STALE-light.png", in: directory))
+        #expect(!fileExists("MapSnapshot-STALE.png", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("SharedWidgetConfig.json", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("knownDevices.plist", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("deviceGroups.plist", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("deviceIDmodern.txt", in: directory))
+        #expect(fileExists("deviceID.plist", in: directory))
+    }
+
+    private func temporaryDirectory() -> URL {
+        let directory = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent(UUID().uuidString, isDirectory: true)
+        try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: directory, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
+        return directory
+    }
+
+    private func write(bytes: [UInt8], named fileName: String, in directory: URL) throws {
+        let url = directory.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
+        try Data(bytes).write(to: url)
+    }
+
+    private func fileExists(_ fileName: String, in directory: URL) -> Bool {
+        FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: directory.appendingPathComponent(fileName).path)
+    }
+}
```

_**Agent (gpt-5.5 2026-05-21 14:34:08Z)**_

Ich sehe die wahrscheinlich kritische Stelle: der Cleanup kann beim Prunen einen Widget-Sync mit einem gerade unvollständigen Cache anstoßen, und die Widget-Loader-Logik verwirft eine konfigurierte Geräte-ID, wenn sie nicht mehr in der aktuellen Payload-Liste auftaucht. Ich patch das so, dass die Widget-Auswahl konservativ erhalten bleibt und Cleanup nicht mitten im Lauf eine teilweise Widget-Payload schreibt.

```
import Foundation
import MiataruAPIClient
#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif

@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
enum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {
    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, generateMapSnapshots: Bool = false) async -> (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {
        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()
        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []
        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()
        let knownIDs = cachedDeviceIDs + (config?.deviceIDs ?? [])
        let targetID = canonicalID(configuration.device?.id, knownIDs: knownIDs)
            ?? cachedPayload?.devices.first?.id
            ?? config?.deviceIDs.first

        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(
            devices: [],
            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,
            ownDevice: nil
        )

        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {
            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }
            return (payload, device)
        }

        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(
            primary: targetID,
            additional: canonicalID(config.ownDeviceID, knownIDs: knownIDs) ?? config.ownDeviceID
        )
        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {
            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }
            return (payload, device)
        }

        do {
            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(
                serverURL: serverURL,
                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,
                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID ?? "",
                requestingDeviceKey: config.ownDeviceKey
            )
            // Track widget-initiated request
            SharedWidgetDataManager.recordWidgetRequest()
            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)
            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)
        } catch {
#if DEBUG
            print("[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \(requestIDs): \(error)")
#endif
            // Fall back to cached payload
        }

        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first
        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }

        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {
            // Generating MKMapSnapshotter images can be slow and may exceed WidgetKit's
            // tight execution budget if awaited during timeline generation.
            // However, detached tasks can be delayed/suspended; we prefer to render the
            // currently displayed appearance synchronously so the widget can update promptly.
            #if canImport(UIKit)
            let preferred = UITraitCollection.current.userInterfaceStyle
            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device, preferredStyle: preferred)

            // Best-effort: also render the other appearance so switching light/dark
            // doesn't force a placeholder as often.
            Task.detached(priority: .background) {
                await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureOtherStyleBestEffort(for: device, preferredStyle: preferred)
            }
            #else
            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)
            #endif
        }

        return (payload, device)
    }

    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -> [String] {
        var ordered: [String] = []
        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {
            ordered.append(primary)
        }
        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {
            ordered.append(additional)
        }
        return ordered
    }

    private static func canonicalID(_ id: String?, knownIDs: [String]) -> String? {
        guard let id, !id.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if let exact = knownIDs.first(where: { $0 == id }) {
            return exact
        }
        let lowercasedID = id.lowercased()
        return knownIDs.first(where: { $0.lowercased() == lowercasedID })
    }

    private static func deviceMatching(_ id: String, in payload: WidgetSharedPayload) -> WidgetDeviceData? {
        if let exact = payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id == id }) {
            return exact
        }
        let lowercasedID = id.lowercased()
        return payload.devices.first(where: { $0.id.lowercased() == lowercasedID })
    }
```

```
@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceQuery: EntityQuery {
    func entities(for identifiers: [DeviceEntity.ID]) async throws -> [DeviceEntity] {
        guard let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read() else { return [] }
        let normalized = identifiers.map { $0.lowercased() }
        return payload.devices
            .filter { normalized.contains($0.id.lowercased()) }
            .map { DeviceEntity(id: $0.id, displayName: $0.name) }
    }

    func suggestedEntities() async throws -> [DeviceEntity] {
        guard let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read() else { return [] }
        return payload.devices.map { DeviceEntity(id: $0.id, displayName: $0.name) }
    }

    func entities(matching query: String) async throws -> [DeviceEntity] {
        guard let payload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read() else { return [] }
        let filtered = payload.devices.filter { $0.name.localizedCaseInsensitiveContains(query) }
        return filtered.map { DeviceEntity(id: $0.id, displayName: $0.name) }
    }
```

```
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2013-2026, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
 *
 * PersistentDataCleanup.swift
 * miataru
 *
 * Created by Codex on 21.05.26.
 */

import Foundation

struct PersistentDataCleanupResult: Equatable {
    let removedLocationCount: Int
    let removedSloganDeviceCount: Int
    let removedSnapshotFileCount: Int
    let removedSnapshotByteCount: Int64

    var didRemoveAnything: Bool {
        removedLocationCount > 0 || removedSloganDeviceCount > 0 || removedSnapshotFileCount > 0
    }
}

@MainActor
enum PersistentDataCleanup {
    @discardableResult
    static func run(snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {
        run(
            knownDevices: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices,
            groups: DeviceGroupStore.shared.groups,
            ownDeviceID: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,
            snapshotContainerURL: snapshotContainerURL
        )
    }

    @discardableResult
    static func run(
        knownDevices: [KnownDevice],
        groups: [DeviceGroup],
        ownDeviceID: String,
        snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL
    ) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {
        let retainedDeviceIDs = retainedDeviceIDs(
            knownDevices: knownDevices,
            groups: groups,
            ownDeviceID: ownDeviceID
        )

        let removedLocationCount = DeviceLocationCacheStore.shared.pruneLocations(
            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs
        )
        let removedSloganDeviceCount = DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.pruneCachedData(
            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs
        )
        let snapshotResult = SharedWidgetDataManager.removeStaleMapSnapshots(
            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs,
            in: snapshotContainerURL
        )

        let result = PersistentDataCleanupResult(
            removedLocationCount: removedLocationCount,
            removedSloganDeviceCount: removedSloganDeviceCount,
            removedSnapshotFileCount: snapshotResult.removedFileCount,
            removedSnapshotByteCount: snapshotResult.removedByteCount
        )

        if result.didRemoveAnything {
            debugLog(
                "[PersistentDataCleanup] Removed \(result.removedLocationCount) location cache entries, " +
                "\(result.removedSloganDeviceCount) slogan cache entries, " +
                "\(result.removedSnapshotFileCount) widget snapshots (\(result.removedSnapshotByteCount) bytes)."
            )
        }

        return result
    }

    static func retainedDeviceIDs(
        knownDevices: [KnownDevice],
        groups: [DeviceGroup],
        ownDeviceID: String
    ) -> Set<String> {
        var retained = Set<String>()

        for device in knownDevices {
            insertNormalized(device.DeviceID, into: &retained)
        }
        for group in groups {
            for deviceID in group.deviceIDs {
                insertNormalized(deviceID, into: &retained)
            }
        }
        insertNormalized(ownDeviceID, into: &retained)

        return retained
    }

    private static func insertNormalized(_ deviceID: String, into retained: inout Set<String>) {
        let normalized = deviceID.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).uppercased()
        guard !normalized.isEmpty else { return }
        retained.insert(normalized)
    }
}
```

```
@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceMapEntry: TimelineEntry {
    let date: Date
    let configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent
    let device: WidgetDeviceData?
    let ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?
}

@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceLocationMapProvider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {
    typealias Entry = DeviceMapEntry
    typealias Intent = DeviceSelectionIntent

    func placeholder(in context: Context) -> DeviceMapEntry {
        DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent(), device: nil, ownDevice: nil)
    }

    func snapshot(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> DeviceMapEntry {
        await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
    }

    func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<DeviceMapEntry> {
        let entry = await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
        // Default refresh cadence. The system may still throttle this.
        var next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)

        // If the map snapshot file is missing or older than the data we’re displaying,
        // ask WidgetKit to give us another chance soon. This helps the widget recover
        // from slow snapshot rendering without "freezing" for long periods.
        if let device = entry.device, needsSnapshotRefresh(for: device) {
            next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 2, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(120)
        }

        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
    }

    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -> DeviceMapEntry {
        let (payload, device) = await WidgetTimelineDataLoader.loadEntryData(configuration: configuration, generateMapSnapshots: true)
        return DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: configuration, device: device, ownDevice: payload.ownDevice)
    }

    private func needsSnapshotRefresh(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -> Bool {
        #if canImport(UIKit)
        let styles: [UIUserInterfaceStyle] = [.light, .dark]
        #else
        let styles: [Any] = []
        #endif

        // Defensive: don't treat far-future timestamps as "always stale"
        // (clock skew can otherwise cause endless snapshot regeneration attempts).
        let referenceTimestamp = min(device.timestamp, Date())

        #if canImport(UIKit)
        for style in styles {
            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id, style: style) else { return true }
            guard let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
                  let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else {
                return true
            }
            if modDate < referenceTimestamp {
                return true
            }
        }
        #endif

        // If we can't evaluate snapshots (non-UIKit platforms), don't force refresh.
        return false
    }
}
```

```
import Foundation

struct SharedWidgetConfig: Codable {
    let miataruServerURL: String
    let deviceIDs: [String]
    let ownDeviceID: String?
    let ownDeviceKey: String?
    let authorizationToken: String?
}

enum SharedWidgetConfigManager {
    private static let configFileName = "SharedWidgetConfig.json"
    private static let appGroupIdentifier = "group.com.miataru.ios"

    static var sharedContainerURL: URL? {
        FileManager.default.containerURL(forSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier: appGroupIdentifier)
    }

    static var configURL: URL? {
        sharedContainerURL?.appendingPathComponent(configFileName)
    }

    static func write(_ config: SharedWidgetConfig) {
        guard let url = configURL else { return }
        do {
            let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(config)
            try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])
        } catch {
            print("Failed to write shared widget config: \(error)")
        }
    }

    static func read() -> SharedWidgetConfig? {
        guard let url = configURL else { return nil }
        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: url) else { return nil }
        do {
            return try JSONDecoder().decode(SharedWidgetConfig.self, from: data)
        } catch {
            print("Failed to decode shared widget config: \(error)")
            return nil
        }
    }
}
```

```
/*
 * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
 *
 * KnownDeviceStore.swift
 * miataru
 *
 * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 20.06.25.
 */

import Foundation
import UIKit
import Combine

// Falls erforderlich, KnownDevice importieren (bei getrennten Modulen):
// import miataru

class KnownDeviceStore: ObservableObject {
    static let shared = KnownDeviceStore()
    
    @Published var devices: [KnownDevice] = [] {
        didSet {
            guard !isInitializing else { return }
            setupSubscribers()
            save()
            WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()
        }
    }
    private let fileName = "knownDevices.plist"
    private var cancellables: [AnyCancellable] = []
    private var isInitializing = true

    private var fileURL: URL {
        AppDirectories.applicationSupportFile(named: fileName)
    }

    // Make init private for singleton
    private init() {
        self.devices = load()
        // Sicherstellen, dass das eigene Gerät immer in der Liste ist
        let myDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID
        if !self.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == myDeviceID }) {
            let myDeviceName = NSLocalizedString("my_device", comment: "Name for the user's own device in the device list")
            let myDevice = KnownDevice(name: myDeviceName, deviceID: myDeviceID, color: UIColor.systemBlue)
            self.devices.insert(myDevice, at: 0)
            debugLog("[DEBUG] Eigenes Gerät mit DeviceID \(myDeviceID) wurde automatisch als erstes Device hinzugefügt.")
            save()
        }
        setupSubscribers()
        isInitializing = false
    }

    private func setupSubscribers() {
        cancellables = []
        for device in devices {
            let c = device.objectWillChange
                .sink { [weak self] _ in
                    self?.save()
                    WidgetDataSyncCoordinator.syncAllDevices()
                }
            cancellables.append(c)
        }
    }

    private func save() {
       do {
            let data = try NSKeyedArchiver.archivedData(withRootObject: devices, requiringSecureCoding: true)
            try data.write(to: fileURL)
        } catch {
            debugLog("Fehler beim Speichern der KnownDevices: \(error)")
        }
        //print("Speichern ist temporär deaktiviert - muss repariert werden!!!")
    }

    private func load() -> [KnownDevice] {
        guard let data = try? Data(contentsOf: fileURL) else { return [] }
        do {
            if let devices = try NSKeyedUnarchiver.unarchivedObject(ofClasses: [NSArray.self, KnownDevice.self, UIColor.self], from: data) as? [KnownDevice] {
                // Nach gespeicherter Reihenfolge sortieren
                return devices.sorted { $0.KnownDevicesTablePosition < $1.KnownDevicesTablePosition }
            }
        } catch {
            debugLog("Fehler beim Laden der KnownDevices: \(error)")
        }
        return []
    }

    /// Fügt ein Gerät hinzu, wenn die DeviceID noch nicht existiert. Gibt true zurück, wenn erfolgreich, false bei Duplikat.
    @discardableResult
    func add(device: KnownDevice) -> Bool {
        if devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == device.DeviceID }) {
            return false
        }
        devices.append(device)
        return true
    }

    func move(fromOffsets source: IndexSet, toOffset destination: Int) {
        devices.move(fromOffsets: source, toOffset: destination)
        // Reihenfolge-Index aktualisieren
        for (index, device) in devices.enumerated() {
            device.KnownDevicesTablePosition = index
        }
        save()
    }

    func remove(atOffsets offsets: IndexSet) {
        // Get device IDs that will be removed
        let deviceIDsToRemove = offsets.map { devices[$0].DeviceID }
        
        // Remove devices from the list
        devices.remove(atOffsets: offsets)
        
        // Remove devices from all groups
        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: deviceIDsToRemove)
        
        save()
    }
    
    func removeDevice(byID deviceID: String) {
        // Remove device from the list
        devices.removeAll { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }
        
        // Remove device from all groups
        removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [deviceID])
        
        save()
    }
    
    private func removeDevicesFromAllGroups(deviceIDs: [String]) {
        let groupStore = DeviceGroupStore.shared
        
        for group in groupStore.groups {
            var changed = false
            for deviceID in deviceIDs {
                if group.deviceIDs.contains(deviceID) {
                    group.removeDevice(deviceID)
                    changed = true
                }
            }
            if changed {
                group.objectWillChange.send()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```
    12	struct PersistentDataCleanupResult: Equatable {

    23	@MainActor

    26	    static func run(snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {
    27	        run(
    28	            knownDevices: KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices,
    29	            groups: DeviceGroupStore.shared.groups,

    36	    static func run(

    40	        snapshotContainerURL: URL? = SharedWidgetDataManager.sharedContainerURL
    41	    ) -> PersistentDataCleanupResult {

    52	        let removedSloganDeviceCount = DeviceSloganCacheStore.shared.pruneCachedData(

    54	        )
    55	        let snapshotResult = SharedWidgetDataManager.removeStaleMapSnapshots(
    56	            retainingDeviceIDs: retainedDeviceIDs,
    57	            in: snapshotContainerURL
    58	        )
    59	
    60	        let result = PersistentDataCleanupResult(
    61	            removedLocationCount: removedLocationCount,
    62	            removedSloganDeviceCount: removedSloganDeviceCount,
```

```
            return
        }

        if needsLight {
            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .light)

            await renderSnapshot(for: device, coordinate: coord, size: size, style: .dark)
```

```
/*
```

```
 *
 * WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.swift
 * miataru
 *
 * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2026-01-06.
 */

import Foundation
import MapKit
import SwiftUI

#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif

/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker) and writes them into
/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.
enum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {
    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {
        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)

            // Render both light and dark variants so widgets can pick based on appearance.
            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .light)
            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .dark)
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, size: CGSize, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {
        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID, style: style) else { return }

        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()
        options.size = size
        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale
        options.mapType = .standard
        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll
        options.showsBuildings = false
        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)
        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)

        do {
            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()
            let markerImage = await markerImage(for: device)
            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size, markerImage: markerImage)
            if let data = image.pngData() {
                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])
            }
        } catch {
            debugLog("Failed to generate widget map snapshot (\(style == .dark ? "dark" : "light")): \(error)")
        }
    }

    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -> MKCoordinateRegion {
        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000
        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)
        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)
        return MKCoordinateRegion(
            center: coordinate,
            latitudinalMeters: radius,
            longitudinalMeters: radius
        )
    }

    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -> UIImage {
        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)

        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        return renderer.image { context in
            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))

            // Draw marker
            let markerSize = markerImage.size
            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(
                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,
                y: point.y - markerSize.height
            )
            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))
        }
    }

    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -> UIImage {
        await MainActor.run {
            let marker = MiataruMapMarker(
                color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),
                height: 44,
                cacheEnabled: false,
                renderPadding: 10
            )
            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)
            renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale
            renderer.isOpaque = false
            return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: "mappin.circle.fill") ?? UIImage()
        }
    }
}
```

Zwei Ursachen zeichnen sich ab: erstens schreibt iPhone-Reorder bisher direkt in `store.devices`, ohne die Positionsfelder zu aktualisieren; beim nächsten Launch kann die App dann eine andere Reihenfolge ins Widget syncen. Zweitens kann die Snapshot-Erzeugung im Widget bei `UITraitCollection.current.userInterfaceStyle == .unspecified` einfach gar keine Light/Dark-Datei rendern.

```diff
+import Testing

+@Suite("Known device ordering")
+struct KnownDeviceStoreOrderingTests {
+    @Test("Tie positions preserve archived order")
+    func tiePositionsPreserveArchivedOrder() {
+        let first = KnownDevice(name: "First", deviceID: "FIRST")
+        let second = KnownDevice(name: "Second", deviceID: "SECOND")
+        first.KnownDevicesTablePosition = 0
+        second.KnownDevicesTablePosition = 0
+
+        let sorted = KnownDeviceStore.devicesSortedByTablePositionPreservingArchiveOrder([first, second])
+
+        #expect(sorted.map(\.DeviceID) == ["FIRST", "SECOND"])
+    }
+
+    @Test("Stored positions still define order")
+    func storedPositionsDefineOrder() {
+        let first = KnownDevice(name: "First", deviceID: "FIRST")
+        let second = KnownDevice(name: "Second", deviceID: "SECOND")
+        first.KnownDevicesTablePosition = 1
+        second.KnownDevicesTablePosition = 0
+
+        let sorted = KnownDeviceStore.devicesSortedByTablePositionPreservingArchiveOrder([first, second])
+
+        #expect(sorted.map(\.DeviceID) == ["SECOND", "FIRST"])
```

Ich habe die beiden wahrscheinlich echten Ursachen jetzt nachgezogen.

Die Widget-Auswahl sollte nicht mehr nach App-Launch kippen: [KnownDeviceStore.swift](</Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/Devices/KnownDeviceStore.swift:37>) normalisiert und stabilisiert die Geräte-Reihenfolge jetzt, und iPhone-Reordering nutzt wieder den Store-Pfad, der Positionswerte aktualisiert: [iPhone_DevicesView.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/iPhone/iPhone_DevicesView.swift:170).

Die Karte sollte wieder erscheinen: [WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift](/Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataruWidgets/WidgetTimelineDataLoader.swift:72) behandelt jetzt `.unspecified` Light/Dark-Style korrekt, sodass das Widget dann beide Snapshot-Varianten rendert statt gar keine. Zusätzlich nutzt der Fallback bei fehlender Entity jetzt die stabile Config-Reihenfolge statt der wechselnden Payload-Reihenfolge.

Verifiziert:
- `miataru/scripts/test-unit.sh` bestanden: 124 Tests in 20 Suites.
- `git diff --check` bestanden.

Nach dem neuen Build sollte ein einmaliger App-Launch die gespeicherten Gerätepositionen normalisieren; danach Widget-Auswahl neu setzen, falls iOS das bestehende Widget bereits auf das falsche Device umkonfiguriert hatte.

```
import WidgetKit
import SwiftUI
import Foundation
import CoreLocation
import MapKit
#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif
import MiataruAPIClient

@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceMapEntry: TimelineEntry {
    let date: Date
    let configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent
    let device: WidgetDeviceData?
    let ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?
}

@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceLocationMapProvider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {
    typealias Entry = DeviceMapEntry
    typealias Intent = DeviceSelectionIntent

    func placeholder(in context: Context) -> DeviceMapEntry {
        DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent(), device: nil, ownDevice: nil)
    }

    func snapshot(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> DeviceMapEntry {
        await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
    }

    func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<DeviceMapEntry> {
        let entry = await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
        // Default refresh cadence. The system may still throttle this.
        var next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)

        // If the map snapshot file is missing or older than the data we’re displaying,
        // ask WidgetKit to give us another chance soon. This helps the widget recover
        // from slow snapshot rendering without "freezing" for long periods.
        if let device = entry.device, needsSnapshotRefresh(for: device) {
            next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 2, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(120)
        }

        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
    }

    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -> DeviceMapEntry {
        let (payload, device) = await WidgetTimelineDataLoader.loadEntryData(configuration: configuration, generateMapSnapshots: true)
        return DeviceMapEntry(date: Date(), configuration: configuration, device: device, ownDevice: payload.ownDevice)
    }

    private func needsSnapshotRefresh(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -> Bool {
        #if canImport(UIKit)
        let styles: [UIUserInterfaceStyle] = [.light, .dark]
        #else
        let styles: [Any] = []
        #endif

        // Defensive: don't treat far-future timestamps as "always stale"
        // (clock skew can otherwise cause endless snapshot regeneration attempts).
        let referenceTimestamp = min(device.timestamp, Date())

            guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.id, style: style) else { return true }

                  let modDate = attrs[.modificationDate] as? Date else {
                return true
            }
            if modDate < referenceTimestamp {
                return true
            }
        }
        #endif

        // If we can't evaluate snapshots (non-UIKit platforms), don't force refresh.
        return false
```
```
    }
}

    private var topFadeOverlay: some View {
        LinearGradient(
            colors: [

            ],

    }

    private func overlay(for device: WidgetDeviceData, family: WidgetFamily) -> some View {
        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)
        let distance = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)
        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)

        let primaryComponents = [device.name, locality, distance].filter { !$0.isEmpty }
        let primaryLine = primaryComponents.joined(separator: " • ")
        let (primaryFont, secondaryFont, spacing, padding) = overlayMetrics(for: family)

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {
            Text(primaryLine)
                .font(primaryFont)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
                .shadow(radius: 2)
            Text(lastUpdate)
                .font(secondaryFont)
                .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.6)
        }
        .foregroundColor(.primary)
        .padding(.vertical, padding)
        .padding(.horizontal, padding + 2)
        .background(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 10)
                .fill(Color(.systemBackground).opacity(family == .systemMedium ? 0.7 : 0.4))
        )
    }

    private func overlayMetrics(for family: WidgetFamily) -> (Font, Font, CGFloat, CGFloat) {
        switch family {
        case .systemMedium:
            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption2, 2, 7)
        case .systemLarge:
            return (.headline, .subheadline, 3, 12)
        default:
            return (.subheadline.weight(.semibold), .caption, 2, 8)
        }
    }

    private var overlayWidthFactor: CGFloat {
        switch family {
        case .systemMedium: return 0.9
        case .systemLarge: return 0.92
        default: return 0.9
        }
    }

    private func formattedLocality(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -> String {
        let locality = device.locality ?? ""
        let country = device.country ?? ""
        let combined = [locality, country].filter { !$0.isEmpty }.joined(separator: ", ")
        if combined.isEmpty {
            return NSLocalizedString("widget_location_unknown", comment: "Shown when no placemark is available for the widget")
        }
        return combined
    }

    private func formattedDistance(to device: WidgetDeviceData, from ownDevice: WidgetDeviceData?) -> String {
        guard let own = ownDevice else {
            return NSLocalizedString("widget_distance_unknown", comment: "Shown when distance cannot be calculated")
        }
        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)
        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)
        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)
        return distanceFormatter.string(fromDistance: meters)
    }

    private var distanceFormatter: MKDistanceFormatter {
        let formatter = MKDistanceFormatter()
        formatter.units = .default
        formatter.unitStyle = .abbreviated
        return formatter
    }

    private func formattedUpdateTimestamp(for date: Date) -> String {
        let label = NSLocalizedString("widget_last_update", comment: "Prefix for last update timestamp")
        let now = Date()
        let stamp: String
        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {
            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)
        } else {
            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)
        }
        return "\(label) \(stamp)"
    }
}

        .description(NSLocalizedString("widget_map_description", comment: "Description for the map widget"))
        .supportedFamilies([.systemMedium, .systemLarge])
        .contentMarginsDisabled()
    }
}
```

```
import Foundation

import UIKit

@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
enum WidgetTimelineDataLoader {
    static func loadEntryData(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, generateMapSnapshots: Bool = false) async -> (WidgetSharedPayload, WidgetDeviceData?) {
        let cachedPayload = SharedWidgetDataManager.read()
        let cachedDeviceIDs = cachedPayload?.devices.map { $0.id } ?? []
        let config = SharedWidgetConfigManager.read()
        let configDeviceIDs = config?.deviceIDs ?? []
        let selectableDeviceIDs = configDeviceIDs.isEmpty ? cachedDeviceIDs : configDeviceIDs
        let knownIDs = cachedDeviceIDs + configDeviceIDs
        let configuredDeviceID = trimmedDeviceID(configuration.device?.id)
        let targetID = canonicalID(configuredDeviceID, knownIDs: selectableDeviceIDs)
            ?? configuredDeviceID

        var payload = cachedPayload ?? WidgetSharedPayload(
            devices: [],
            ownDeviceID: config?.ownDeviceID,
            ownDevice: nil
        )

        guard let config, let serverURL = URL(string: config.miataruServerURL) else {
            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }
            return (payload, device)
        }

        let requestIDs = uniqueDeviceIDs(
            primary: targetID,
            additional: canonicalID(config.ownDeviceID, knownIDs: knownIDs) ?? config.ownDeviceID
        )
        guard !requestIDs.isEmpty else {
            let device = targetID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }
            return (payload, device)
        }

        do {
            let locations = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocation(
                serverURL: serverURL,
                forDeviceIDs: requestIDs,
                requestingDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID ?? "",
                requestingDeviceKey: config.ownDeviceKey
            )
            // Track widget-initiated request
            SharedWidgetDataManager.recordWidgetRequest()
            payload = merge(locations, into: payload, cached: cachedPayload, ownDeviceID: config.ownDeviceID ?? payload.ownDeviceID)
            SharedWidgetDataManager.write(payload)
        } catch {
#if DEBUG
            print("[Widget] Failed to fetch locations for IDs \(requestIDs): \(error)")
#endif
            // Fall back to cached payload
        }

        let selectedDeviceID = targetID ?? requestIDs.first ?? cachedDeviceIDs.first
        let device = selectedDeviceID.flatMap { id in deviceMatching(id, in: payload) }

        if generateMapSnapshots, let device {
            // Generating MKMapSnapshotter images can be slow and may exceed WidgetKit's
            // tight execution budget if awaited during timeline generation.
            // However, detached tasks can be delayed/suspended; we prefer to render the
            // currently displayed appearance synchronously so the widget can update promptly.
            #if canImport(UIKit)
            let preferred = concreteInterfaceStyle(UITraitCollection.current.userInterfaceStyle)
            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device, preferredStyle: preferred)

            // Best-effort: also render the other appearance so switching light/dark
            // doesn't force a placeholder as often.
            if let preferred {
                Task.detached(priority: .background) {
                    await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureOtherStyleBestEffort(for: device, preferredStyle: preferred)
                }
            }
            #else
            await WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator.ensureSnapshotsUpToDate(for: device)
            #endif
        }

        return (payload, device)
    }

    private static func uniqueDeviceIDs(primary: String?, additional: String?) -> [String] {
        var ordered: [String] = []
        if let primary, !primary.isEmpty {
            ordered.append(primary)
        }
        if let additional, !additional.isEmpty, !ordered.contains(additional) {
            ordered.append(additional)
        }
        return ordered
    }

    private static func canonicalID(_ id: String?, knownIDs: [String]) -> String? {
        guard let id = trimmedDeviceID(id) else { return nil }
        if let exact = knownIDs.first(where: { $0 == id }) {
            return exact
        }
        let lowercasedID = id.lowercased()
        return knownIDs.first(where: { $0.lowercased() == lowercasedID })
    }
```

```
        #endif

        // (clock skew can otherwise cause endless snapshot regeneration attempts).

            }
        }
        #endif

        // If we can't evaluate snapshots (non-UIKit platforms), don't force refresh.
        return false
    }
}
```

```
        }
        let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: device.latitude, longitude: device.longitude)
        let ownLocation = CLLocation(latitude: own.latitude, longitude: own.longitude)
        let meters = deviceLocation.distance(from: ownLocation)

        let label = NSLocalizedString("widget_last_update", comment: "Prefix for last update timestamp")
        let now = Date()
        let stamp: String
        if Calendar.current.isDate(date, inSameDayAs: now) {
            stamp = date.formatted(date: .omitted, time: .shortened)
        } else {
            stamp = date.formatted(date: .abbreviated, time: .shortened)
        }
        return "\(label) \(stamp)"
    }
```

```
import Foundation
import MapKit
import SwiftUI

#if canImport(UIKit)
import UIKit
#endif

/// Generates pre-rendered map images (with a device marker) and writes them into
/// the shared App Group container for WidgetKit consumption.
enum WidgetMapSnapshotGenerator {
    static func generateSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize = CGSize(width: 400, height: 400)) {
        Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
            let coordinate = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: location.latitude, longitude: location.longitude)

            // Render both light and dark variants so widgets can pick based on appearance.
            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .light)
            await renderSnapshot(for: device, location: location, coordinate: coordinate, size: size, style: .dark)
        }
    }

    @MainActor
    private static func renderSnapshot(for device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, size: CGSize, style: UIUserInterfaceStyle) async {
        guard let url = SharedWidgetDataManager.mapSnapshotURL(for: device.DeviceID, style: style) else { return }

        let options = MKMapSnapshotter.Options()
        options.size = size
        options.scale = UIScreen.main.scale
        options.mapType = .standard
        options.pointOfInterestFilter = .excludingAll
        options.showsBuildings = false
        options.region = region(for: coordinate, accuracy: location.accuracy)
        options.traitCollection = UITraitCollection(userInterfaceStyle: style)

        do {
            let snapshot = try await MKMapSnapshotter(options: options).start()
            let markerImage = await markerImage(for: device)
            let image = render(snapshot: snapshot, coordinate: coordinate, device: device, location: location, size: size, markerImage: markerImage)
            if let data = image.pngData() {
                try data.write(to: url, options: [.atomic])
            }
        } catch {
            debugLog("Failed to generate widget map snapshot (\(style == .dark ? "dark" : "light")): \(error)")
        }
    }

    private static func region(for coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, accuracy: Double?) -> MKCoordinateRegion {
        let baseMeters: CLLocationDistance = 4000
        let extra = max(accuracy ?? 0, 0)
        let radius = max(baseMeters, extra * 4)
        return MKCoordinateRegion(
            center: coordinate,
            latitudinalMeters: radius,
            longitudinalMeters: radius
        )
    }

    private static func render(snapshot: MKMapSnapshotter.Snapshot, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, device: KnownDevice, location: CachedDeviceLocation, size: CGSize, markerImage: UIImage) -> UIImage {
        let point = snapshot.point(for: coordinate)

        let renderer = UIGraphicsImageRenderer(size: size)
        return renderer.image { context in
            snapshot.image.draw(in: CGRect(origin: .zero, size: size))

            // Draw marker
            let markerSize = markerImage.size
            let markerOrigin = CGPoint(
                x: point.x - markerSize.width / 2,
                y: point.y - markerSize.height
            )
            markerImage.draw(in: CGRect(origin: markerOrigin, size: markerSize))
        }
    }

    private static func markerImage(for device: KnownDevice) async -> UIImage {
        await MainActor.run {
            let marker = MiataruMapMarker(
                color: Color(device.DeviceColor ?? UIColor.systemBlue),
                height: 44,
                cacheEnabled: false,
                renderPadding: 10
            )
            let renderer = ImageRenderer(content: marker)
            renderer.scale = UIScreen.main.scale
            renderer.isOpaque = false
            return renderer.uiImage ?? UIImage(systemName: "mappin.circle.fill") ?? UIImage()
        }
    }
}
```

```
+    static func removeStaleMapSnapshots(

+        in containerURL: URL? = sharedContainerURL,

+    ) -> WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult {
+        guard let containerURL else {
+            return WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult(removedFileCount: 0, removedByteCount: 0)
+        }
+
+        let normalizedRetainedDeviceIDs = Set(
+            retainedDeviceIDs

+        ) else {

+        }
+
+        var removedFileCount = 0
+        var removedByteCount: Int64 = 0
+
+        for fileURL in contents {
+            guard ((try? fileURL.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey]))?.isRegularFile ?? false) else {
+                continue
+            }
+            guard let deviceID = snapshotDeviceID(from: fileURL.lastPathComponent),
+                  !normalizedRetainedDeviceIDs.contains(normalizedDeviceID(deviceID)) else {
+                continue
+            }
+
+            let fileSize = snapshotFileSize(fileURL, fileManager: fileManager)
+            do {
+                try fileManager.removeItem(at: fileURL)
+                removedFileCount += 1
+                removedByteCount += fileSize
+            } catch {
+                debugLog("Failed to remove stale widget map snapshot \(fileURL.lastPathComponent): \(error)")
+            }
+        }
+
+        return WidgetSnapshotCleanupResult(
+            removedFileCount: removedFileCount,
+            removedByteCount: removedByteCount

+    private static func snapshotDeviceID(from fileName: String) -> String? {
+        guard fileName.lowercased().hasSuffix(".\(snapshotExtension)") else { return nil }
+        guard let prefix = cleanupSnapshotPrefixes.first(where: { fileName.hasPrefix($0) }) else { return nil }
+
+        let withoutPrefix = String(fileName.dropFirst(prefix.count))
+        let withoutExtension = String(withoutPrefix.dropLast(snapshotExtension.count + 1))
+        let deviceID: String
+        if withoutExtension.hasSuffix("-dark") {
+            deviceID = String(withoutExtension.dropLast("-dark".count))
+        } else if withoutExtension.hasSuffix("-light") {
+            deviceID = String(withoutExtension.dropLast("-light".count))
+        } else {

+        }

+        }
+        return 0
```

```
@available(iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0, tvOS 17.0, watchOS 10.0, *)
struct DeviceLocationTextProvider: AppIntentTimelineProvider {
    typealias Entry = DeviceLocationEntry
    typealias Intent = DeviceSelectionIntent

    func placeholder(in context: Context) -> DeviceLocationEntry {
        DeviceLocationEntry(date: Date(), configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent(), device: nil, ownDevice: nil)
    }

    func snapshot(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> DeviceLocationEntry {
        await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
    }

    func timeline(for configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent, in context: Context) async -> Timeline<DeviceLocationEntry> {
        let entry = await buildEntry(configuration: configuration)
        let next = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .minute, value: 15, to: Date()) ?? Date().addingTimeInterval(900)
        return Timeline(entries: [entry], policy: .after(next))
    }

    private func buildEntry(configuration: DeviceSelectionIntent) async -> DeviceLocationEntry {
        let (payload, device) = await WidgetTimelineDataLoader.loadEntryData(configuration: configuration)
        return DeviceLocationEntry(
            date: Date(),
            configuration: configuration,
            device: device,
            ownDevice: payload.ownDevice
        )
    }
}

struct DeviceLocationTextWidgetEntryView: View {
    @Environment(\.widgetFamily) private var family
    let entry: DeviceLocationEntry

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            if let device = entry.device {
                content(for: device)
                    .widgetURL(URL(string: "miataru://\(device.id)"))
            } else {
                placeholder
            }
        }
        .containerBackground(for: .widget) {
            ContainerRelativeShape()
                .fill(Color(.systemBackground))
        }
    }

    private func content(for device: WidgetDeviceData) -> some View {
        let distanceText = formattedDistance(to: device, from: entry.ownDevice)
        let locality = formattedLocality(for: device)
        let lastUpdate = formattedUpdateTimestamp(for: device.timestamp)

        let (nameFont, detailFont, distanceFont, updateFont, spacing, padding) = metrics(for: family)

        return VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: spacing) {
            Text(device.name)
                .font(nameFont)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
            Text(locality)
                .font(detailFont)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
            if family != .accessoryRectangular {
                Text(distanceText)
                    .font(distanceFont)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
                Text(lastUpdate)
                    .font(updateFont)
                    .foregroundStyle(.secondary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
            } else {
                Text(distanceText)
                    .font(distanceFont)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .minimumScaleFactor(0.7)
            }
        }
        .padding(padding)
    }
```

```
    static func color(from uiColor: UIColor?) -> WidgetColor? {
        guard let uiColor else { return nil }

        var b: CGFloat = 0

        uiColor.getRed(&r, green: &g, blue: &b, alpha: &a)
```
